tools.name: find_artworks
tools.description: Find artworks by series name or artwork title (partial match). Facts only, no prices.

tools.name: list_artworks
tools.description: List artworks (titles, series, sizes, availability, links), optionally only available or one series.

tools.name: get_price_rule
tools.description: Artist-approved price for one artwork in US dollars, shipping included (e.g. '$1,050', 'sold').

tools.name: request_viewing
tools.description: Send the artist a viewing or purchase request by email. The artist replies to the given email personally.
